name: Notify Slack Action
description: Send Github Actions workflow status notifications to Slack

token.description: Github Token for accessing workflow url

notification_title.description: Specify on the notification message title

message_format.description: Specify on the notification message format

footer.description: Specify the footer of the message

notify_when.description: Specify on which events a slack notification is sent

mention_users.description: Specify the slack IDs of users you want to mention

mention_users_when.description: Specify on which events you want to mention the users

mention_groups.description: Specify the slack IDs of groups you want to mention

mention_groups_when.description: Specify on which events you want to mention the groups

icon_success.description: Specify on icon to be used when event is success

icon_failure.description: Specify on icon to be used when event is failure

icon_cancelled.description: Specify on icon to be used when event is cancelled

icon_warnings.description: Specify on icon to be used when event is warnings

icon_skipped.description: Specify on icon to be used when event is skipped
